cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Normal-mapped asphalt, leather, brick walls, and metallic props in Marmoset Toolbag, Frostbite, Blender EEVEE, and Three.js
Catching reflection vectors R = reflect(-V, N_ts) that tilt by 2*theta_n below the macroscopic geometric floor (R . N_macro < 0)
Suppressing the 0.5928-0.7737 grazing Schlick Fresnel underground neon rim leak at theta_R in [91.5 deg, 114.0 deg]
Replacing 64-ray upper-hemisphere horizon visibility checks with a single dot(R, N_macro) gate
not_for: True displaced geometry where macro triangles already match the micro-bump slope
Purely diffuse Oren-Nayar or Lambertian shading that does not evaluate mirror reflection vectors R
Transmissive refractive glass where rays intentionally enter the lower hemisphere (use Walter BTDF Round 109)
